*PharmaCraft Daily - 06 Nov 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (Antiviral/Fungal/Protozoal/Helminth)
Q: Acyclovir is used to treat infections caused by?
Ans: Herpes simplex virus
Why: Acyclovir is phosphorylated by viral thymidine kinase and inhibits herpes viral DNA polymerase.

🌍 *FMGE* (Antiviral/Fungal/Protozoal/Helminth)
Q: Primaquine is added in vivax malaria to kill the?
Ans: Hypnozoites in the liver
Why: Primaquine eliminates dormant liver hypnozoites of P. vivax/ovale, preventing relapse.

🩺 *NEET PG* (Antiviral/Fungal/Protozoal/Helminth)
Q: Which HIV drug class ends in '-vir' and blocks the viral protease?
Ans: Protease inhibitors (e.g., ritonavir)
Why: Protease inhibitors (ritonavir, atazanavir) block maturation; ritonavir is also a CYP3A4 booster.

🏥 *INI-CET* (Antiviral/Fungal/Protozoal/Helminth)
Q: Why is ritonavir added in low dose to other protease inhibitors?
Ans: CYP3A4 inhibition boosts levels of the partner drug
Why: Ritonavir is a pharmacokinetic 'booster' inhibiting CYP3A4 to raise levels of co-administered protease inhibitors.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Paper II: Clinical Pharmacology)
Q: Post-marketing surveillance corresponds to which phase?
Ans: Phase IV
Why: Phase IV (post-marketing) detects rare/long-term adverse effects after approval.
